 When is Karwa Chauth in 2026? Check Date, Moonrise Time and Significance
 By Prabhat Mishra Last Updated: Oct 22, 2026, 18:33 IST Karwa Chauth 2026 will be celebrated on October 29. Check the date, moonrise time in Delhi, puja muhurat, fasting rituals and significance of the festival.
 When is Karwa Chauth in 2026? Check Date, Moonrise Time and Significance 
 Karwa Chauth is an important festival which is celebrated all over India. On this day, women observe for taking fast, and pray for the long life, good health, and happiness of their partner. This festival is celebrated in a traditional way by following the rituals. 
 In 2026, it will be celebrated on Thursday, 29th October, 2026. So. let’s explore this article in detail and know the moon's rise time and significance in detail.

 What Is the Meaning of Karwa Chauth? 
 The name Karwa Chauth has two parts. “Karwa” refers to the small earthen pot traditionally used during the rituals, while “Chauth” means the fourth day of the lunar fortnight. 
 This festival falls on the fourth day of the Krishna Paksha in the Hindu month of Kartik. Since, the hindu follows the lunar calendar, that's why every year, the date of the Karwa Chauth also differs every year. 
 Why Is Karwa Chauth Celebrated? 
 Karwa Chauth is traditionally observed by the Hindu married women who pray for the long life, better health, and prosperity of their partners. 
 Women usually observe having a fast from sunrise until the moon has not sighted, and after seeing the moon, they drink the water from their partners. 
 However, this tradition and customs can vary from one family and region to another. This festival is celebrated all over India, but it is more popular in states such as Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, & Madhya Pradesh. 
 Karwa Chauth 2026 Moonrise Time 
 The evening puja is an important part of Karwa Chauth. Women worship Goddess Parvati, Lord Shiva and Lord Ganesha and listen to the Karwa Chauth Vrat Katha according to their family traditions. 
 For New Delhi, the expected puja and Moonrise timings are given below.

 The Moon may rise at different times in different cities. Therefore, people should check their local Panchang before planning the puja. 
 What Is the Significance of Karwa Chauth? 
 Karwa Chauth has religious, cultural and family significance. Its main importance is explained below. 
 Prayers for a happy life: Women pray for the health, happiness and long life of their husbands. 
 Religious importance: Devotees worship Goddess Parvati, Lord Shiva and Lord Ganesha during the puja. 
 Importance of the Moon: The Moon is worshipped in the evening, and sighting it is an important part of completing the traditional fast. 
 Family traditions: Sargi, mehndi, traditional clothes and the exchange of gifts make the festival special for many families.
